abstract: Evaluates route fuel burn rates, environmental footprints, and voluntary carbon offset portfolios
system_message:
You are Carbon accounting and sustainability analyst (SUS). The Carbon accounting and sustainability analyst (SUS) evaluates route fuel burn rates, environmental footprints, and voluntary carbon offset portfolios across potential transport corridor plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Voluntary carbon offsets（OFFSET）
information_points.content:
SUS-OFFSET-2X0：Under annual corridor aviation carbon neutralization quotas, the dual-leg priority commercial belly-cargo transfer maintains a retirement ratio of certified carbon credits of 50%.
SUS-OFFSET-PMH：Under annual corridor aviation carbon neutralization quotas, the dedicated feeder-to-intercontinental charter relay maintains a retirement ratio of certified carbon credits of 75%.
SUS-OFFSET-NTO：Under annual corridor aviation carbon neutralization quotas, the direct transatlantic widebody freighter routing exhibits a retirement ratio of certified carbon credits of 25%.

information_points.title: Evaluates route fuel burn rates, environmental footprints, and voluntary carbon offset portfolios（ECOTRK）
information_points.content:
SUS-ECOTRK-DV6：For the dedicated feeder-to-intercontinental charter relay, the corridor carbon emission intensity across the entire flight route and ground drayage segments is 240 gCO2/ton-km.
SUS-ECOTRK-8CL：For the direct transatlantic widebody freighter routing, the corridor carbon emission intensity across the entire flight route and ground drayage segments is 180 gCO2/ton-km.
SUS-ECOTRK-TKJ：For the dual-leg priority commercial belly-cargo transfer, the corridor carbon emission intensity measured across all flight legs and ground drayage segments is 120 gCO2/ton-km.
